module: UDP OutGauge protocol (Live For Speed compatible): sends speed, RPM, gear, turbo pressure, temperatures, fuel, pedal inputs and warning lights of the vehicle for external dashboards. Loaded by protocols.lua; address, port and rate come from the settings protocols_outgauge_address, _port, _maxUpdateRate. Uses the graphics step (low cost).
usage: -- Activation: setting 'protocols_outgauge_enabled'. In OutGauge dashboard software, listen on the configured UDP port.
notes: Packet (C struct): unsigned time (always 0); char car[4] = "beam"; unsigned short flags; char gear; char plid (0); float speed (m/s); rpm (RPM); turbo (bar); engTemp (°C); fuel (0..1); oilPressure (0, not handled); oilTemp (°C); unsigned dashLights; unsigned showLights; float throttle, brake, clutch (0..1); char display1[16], display2[16] (empty); int id (0).

flags = OG_KM + OG_BAR (+ OG_TURBO if electrics.turboBoost exists): indicates km/h and bar units. Turbo is converted from psi (electrics.turboBoost / 14.504). OG_x values: 8192 turbo, 16384 km, 32768 bar.
gear = electrics.gearIndex + 1: 0 reverse, 1 neutral, 2 first, etc. (gearIndex is -1 in reverse).
speed = electrics.wheelspeed, otherwise airspeed; rpm = electrics.rpm; engTemp = electrics.watertemp; oilTemp = electrics.oiltemp; fuel = electrics.fuel.

Warning lights dashLights/showLights (bits 2^n): SHIFT 0 (if a shiftLights controller is present, electrics.shouldShift), FULLBEAM 1 (highbeam), HANDBRAKE 2 (parkingbrake), TC 4 (esc or tcs active, only if electrics.hasESC), SIGNAL_L 5 / SIGNAL_R 6 (turn signals), OILWARN 8 (electrics.oil), BATTERY 9 (engine stopped: engineRunning == 0), ABS 10 (electrics.absActive, only if hasABS). PITSPEED 3, SIGNAL_ANY 7, SPARE 11 are not used (N/A).
Bug/inconsistency: fillStruct does an early `return` if electrics.values.watertemp is nil, but protocols.lua still sends the packet (filled with zeros) because the send happens after the call.

Potential bug: electrics.values.gearIndex is not guarded: if it is nil, the addition raises an error. The `~= 0` comparisons of the lights assume numeric values (nil ~= 0 is true and lights the indicator if the electrics value does not exist: highbeam, parkingbrake, signal_L, signal_R, oil).

init.desc: Looks for controllers of type shiftLights to know whether the shift light is available.

getMaxUpdateRate.desc: Maximum sending rate in Hz (setting protocols_outgauge_maxUpdateRate).

isPhysicsStepUsed.desc: Indicates that this protocol is updated in the graphics loop.

getStructDefinition.desc: Returns the C definition of the OutGauge packet (text passed to ffi.cdef).

fillStruct.desc: Fills the packet from electrics.values (speed, RPM, gear, turbo, temperatures, fuel, pedals, warning lights).

o.desc: C struct of the packet to fill (zeroed before the call).

dtSim.desc: Simulation time accumulated since the last send (not used).
